description: Na₆Cd(SnS₃)₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CdS₆ octahedra, corners with four SnS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CdS₆ octahedra, edges with four SnS₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-10°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.81-2.98 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded to six S atoms to form NaS₆ octahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CdS₆ octahedra, corners with four SnS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CdS₆ octahedra, edges with four SnS₆ octahedra, and edges with six equivalent NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-12°. There are a spread of Na-S bond distances ranging from 2.76-2.98 Å. Cd is bonded to six S atoms to form CdS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra, edges with six NaS₆ octahedra, and edges with six SnS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 8-12°. There are two shorter (2.74 Å) and four longer (2.76 Å) Cd-S bond lengths. There are two inequivalent Sn sites. In the first Sn site, Sn is bonded to six S atoms to form SnS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one CdS₆ octahedra, edges with three SnS₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-10°. There are a spread of Sn-S bond distances ranging from 2.57-2.67 Å. In the second Sn site, Sn is bonded to six S atoms to form SnS₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaS₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent CdS₆ octahedra, edges with three SnS₆ octahedra, and edges with six NaS₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 7-10°. There are a spread of Sn-S bond distances ranging from 2.55-2.66 Å. There are four inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to three Na, one Cd, and two equivalent Sn atoms to form SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra that share corners with three SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, corners with three SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, edges with seven SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, and edges with five SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°. In the second S site, S is bonded to three Na and two equivalent Sn atoms to form SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids that share corners with three SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, corners with six equivalent SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, edges with five SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, and edges with three SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 2-4°. In the third S site, S is bonded to three Na and two Sn atoms to form SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids that share corners with three SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, corners with six SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, edges with six SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, and edges with two SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 3-9°. In the fourth S site, S is bonded to three Na, one Cd, and two Sn atoms to form SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra that share corners with three SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, corners with three SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids, edges with six SNa₃CdSn₂ octahedra, and edges with six SNa₃Sn₂ square pyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-3°.
